subject: CPNX GCP Private Offer — Rev-share & Term Alignment (Exec Approval Requested)
messages:
From: Claire Zhang <claire@cpnx.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: GCP Marketplace Rep <gcp-marketplace@google.com>, Legal (CPNX) <legal@cpnx.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Private Offer Draft & Rev-share ask

Priyom / Marissa —

Thanks for the demo last week. Per our procurement and marketplace team, CPNX would like to proceed via GCP Private Offer. A couple of asks from our side to get procurement signoff:

- Rev-share: CPNX requests 30% rev-share on marketplace billings for the first 24 months (they cite integration/marketing commitments).
- Term: 24-month minimum initial term with a 90-day termination notice after year 1.
- Onboarding credit: 3 months of free dedicated capacity credits to offset migration.

Attached is a draft private offer template from our side and a note from our legal team. Can Redwood confirm these are acceptable or share a counter? We need pricing alignment to finalize the PO by Feb 22.

Claire Zhang
Head of Partnerships, CPNX
claire@cpnx.com

Attachments: CPNX_PrivateOffer_v2.docx (proposal), CPNX_terms_summary.pdf (stub)

From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>

Cc: Claire Zhang <claire@cpnx.com>

Subject: Fwd: Private Offer Draft & Rev-share ask — need exec guidance

Marissa / Jonas / David — forwarding CPNX request. Summary: 30% rev-share for 24 months plus 3-month onboarding credit. They want termination protection (90-day notice) and a long initial term. This is outside our standard marketplace playbook (we typically do rev-share <= 20% and 12-month initial terms).

Can we: 1) quantify P&L impact (David), 2) get legal redline risk on 24-month term and termination (Jonas), and 3) recommend an approval ask for execs (Marissa) — e.g., approve up to X% rev-share and commit term.

CPNX is requesting PO by Feb 22; procurement is pushing. I attached our rev-share model.

Thanks —
Priyom
Enterprise Account Executive, Redwood Inference
priyom@redwood.ai

Attachments: redwood_revshare_model.xlsx

From: David Kim <david@redwood.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 17 Feb 2027 11:27:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Fwd: Private Offer Draft & Rev-share ask — P&L impact

Team — quick P&L snapshot after modeling the 30% rev-share request:

- Baseline ARR (first 12 months run-rate): $1.2M
- GCP marketplace fee passthrough estimate: 8% effective
- 30% rev-share reduces Redwood net take to ~62% of gross (after marketplace fee), roughly a $360k delta vs our standard 18% rev-share scenario in year 1.
- One-time onboarding credit (3 months) reduces near-term cash by ~$45k (capacity credits cost).

If we offered a staged rev-share (20% Y1, 25% Y2) the 24-month blended hit is ~18% less than CPNX ask, preserving ~70% net vs gross.

Reqs for exec ask: approval for rev-share >20% OR initial term >12 months. Legal to confirm contractual exposure for 24-month term. Finance needs to mark this deal as a marketplace exception and include in ARR guidance.

-David Kim
Head of Revenue Finance
david@redwood.ai

From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david@redwood.ai>
Cc: Claire Zhang <claire@cpnx.com>
Date: Wed, 17 Feb 2027 16:10:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Fwd: Private Offer Draft & Rev-share ask — legal redline

Priyom — I reviewed CPNX's draft (attached redline: gcp_offer_terms_redlined.pdf). Key legal flags:

1) 24-month minimum with narrow termination is a risk — it prevents us from responding to material regressions. Recommend 12-month initial term with an auto-renewal option unless exec directs otherwise.
2) Audit & data residency clauses need tightening (GCP marketplace data flows). Require a defined SOC2-scope statement and audit window.
3) Indemnity and limitation caps: their language removes our usual liability cap tied to fees — push to retain standard cap.
4) Rev-share mechanics: their proposal implies we pay the rev-share on gross GCP invoice rather than net after marketplace fees — we must insist rev-share be calculated on net receipt after marketplace fees and taxes.

Bottom line: legal will not approve >20% rev-share combined with a 24-month locked term without exec signoff. If sales wants to proceed at 24 months + 30% rev-share, we need explicit signoff from CEO/CFO.

-Jonas Weber
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
jonas@redwood.ai

From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
Cc: Claire Zhang <claire@cpnx.com>, GCP Marketplace Rep <gcp-marketplace@google.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Feb 2027 09:08:00 -0800
Subject: Exec approval request: recommended deal terms for CPNX (need sign-off by EOD 18th)

Vivek —

As discussed, CPNX requires a private offer decision by end of day tomorrow. Recommendation based on finance/legal:

- Rev-share: Approve up to 20% rev-share for Year 1, with an option to increase to 25% in Year 2 contingent on usage thresholds (staged, documented in SOW).
- Term: 12-month initial term (compromise). Auto-renew by 12-month increments thereafter unless either party provides 60 days notice.
- Onboarding credit: Approve 1 month of dedicated capacity credit (compared to their 3-month ask).
- Calculation: Rev-share paid on net receipt after marketplace fees and taxes (per legal).
- Condition: Legal to finalize redline and ensure liability cap preserved; Finance to record marketplace exception and model impact to ARR.

If you approve the above, I will send the counter-offer to CPNX now and ask them to confirm by Feb 22. If you prefer to grant a larger concession (one-time marketing fund or higher rev-share), please state exact parameters.

Attached: redline, P&L model, CPNX proposal.

Thanks —
Priyom
Enterprise Account Executive, Redwood Inference
priyom@redwood.ai

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>

Date: Thu, 18 Feb 2027 15:43:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Exec approval request: recommended deal terms for CPNX (need sign-off by EOD 18th)

Approved, with conditions:

1) Approve the recommended commercial: 20% rev-share Y1, up to 25% Y2 tied to usage triggers; 12-month initial term with 60-day renewal notice.
2) One month onboarding credit approved; any additional marketing funds to be evaluated via a separate MDF request.
3) Legal must confirm rev-share calculation language (net of marketplace fees) and preserve our liability cap before counter is sent.
4) Finance to log the deal as a marketplace exception (DEAL-2027-0147) and include the incremental impact in the upcoming revenue forecast.

Priyom — proceed to send the counter and lock PO deadline to Feb 22. If CPNX insists on 24 months / 30% rev-share, escalate back to me with their justification and expected ARR upside.

Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Global Sales — Redwood Inference
